title: On the existence of linear rank-metric intersecting codes
summary: Intersecting codes are a classical object in coding theory whose rank-metric analogue has recently been introduced. Although the definition formally parallels the Hamming-metric case, the structure and parameter constraints of rank-metric intersecting codes exhibit substantially different behavior. It was previously shown that a nondegenerate $[n,k,d]_{q^m/q}$ rank-metric intersecting code must satisfy $2k-1 \le n \le 2m-3$, and the tightness of the upper bound was left open.
